items.title: 3 Refining Stocks To Watch As Cheaper Crude Tests Margins
items.summary: Oil markets have quietly flipped from scarcity headlines to talk of surplus, with weaker demand, fuller tanks and a softer geopolitical risk premium all pulling on crude prices at once. That shift can reshape the economics of refiners and petrochemical producers, changing who benefits from cheaper feedstock and who simply earns less on every barrel processed. This article unpacks that story and profiles 3 stocks exposed to these forces. The three stocks below are just a starting sample, and...
